effects.description:
When the user has moved continuously for a set period of time, movement/Normal Attack abilities will undergo a change.
These changes will be removed if the user does anything other than moving, dodging, or a Normal Attack.
The damage of the changed Normal Attack will be based on your DEF instead of your ATK, and it will ignore the enemy's DEF.
 When dealing damage with the changed Normal Attack, there is a 50% chance to inflict Freeze for 6 seconds.

skills.detail:
A long-range area attack with a Knockback effect.

Damage dealt will be based on your DEF instead of your ATK.
Attack ignores obstacles.
Deals increased damage to Runners.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
Acquires ATK debuff effect at Level 5.
skills.name: Godhead of Finance's Flash

skills.detail:
While the skill button is held down, you are able to move.
After a certain amount of time has passed or after you let go of the skill button, perform a long-range multiple hit area attack with a chance to inflict Freeze.

Damage dealt will be based on your DEF instead of your ATK.
Deals increased damage to Runners.
Become temporarily invincible after use.
Acquires ATK debuff effect at Level 5.
